name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Oil companies see soaring profits amid Iran war
changes.summary: As the threat of escalation in the war with Iran drives gas prices higher and hurts economies worldwide, one sector is doing really well, the revenue for Big Oil. Ali Bauman explains.

changes.title: Trump says deal to end Iran war may be imminent, agrees to "cancel the attack"
changes.summary: On Saturday, Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman spoke with Mr. Trump and cautioned him against conducting a fresh round of strikes on Iran, CBS News learned.

changes.title: Trump climbs down on Iran strikes after Saudi alarm and threats from Tehran
changes.summary: President claims delay is ‘subject to being able to rapidly make a deal’ as intervention by Saudi crown prince is revealed and Iran warns neighbours Donald Trump said on Saturday night that the US would hold off on any new strikes on Iran provided a deal to end the months-long conflict is quickly reached – marking the.

changes.title: Trump says he has canceled a planned attack on Iran after reaching an agreement over the 'perimeters of a deal'
changes.summary: The U.S. president said Iran and its regional neighbors asked the U.S. to hold off any attacks after 'the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to'.

changes.title: Trump says he's cancelling Iran strikes, deal pending
changes.summary: Trump said that Iran and other Middle Eastern countries had asked the U.S. "to hold off any attack" on Iran because "the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to." (Image credit: Jacquelyn Martin).

changes.title: Trump Says He Is Canceling Strikes on Iran, Pending a Rapid Deal
changes.summary: President Trump said he agreed to requests from Iran and other Middle Eastern countries to cancel planned attacks, citing what he said was progress in reaching the “perimeters of a deal” with Tehran.

changes.title: Fact-Checking Trump’s Claims About the Effect of the Iran War on Oil Prices, Munitions and More
changes.summary: The president misleadingly blamed the Biden administration’s weapons transfers to Ukraine for current concerns over munitions stockpiles, among other claims about the Iran war.

changes.title: U.S., Israel preparing to bombard energy-related targets in Iran, sources say
changes.summary: The U.S. and Israel plan to hit Iran's energy infrastructure as soon as this weekend, although no final decision has been made, sources familiar with the matter told CBS News.

changes.title: Scope of Hacks on U.S. Water Supply Widens as Evidence Points to Iran
changes.summary: Michigan and Minnesota are among at least seven states coping with cyberattacks aimed at disrupting water systems nationwide.

changes.title: U.S. probes if Iran was behind cyberattack on utilities in Michigan, Minnesota
changes.summary: Malicious cyber activity affected technology at water systems in at least seven states this week, including Minnesota, leading authorities to dig into whether Iranian actors are behind the attack, CBS News has learned.
